# V2 Event Graph — connections & dependencies

*Generated by tools/event-graph.mjs. Do not edit by hand.*

Every arrow below is enforced by CI (`npm run check` extends here): an unlock,
block, or alter referencing a missing event id fails validation. Flags named
`sets:` are durable world state; `requires:` gates eligibility.

## QUEBEC_REFERENDUM_1995 — The Quebec Referendum, Round Two
*universal, 1995–1995*

- choice **Yes side wins — begin separation negotiations**: sets `quebecStatus=independent-negotiating`; unlocks **QUEBEC_NEGOTIATION_1996**; blocks ~~MEECH_LAKE_1992~~

## QUEBEC_NEGOTIATION_1996 — Separation Negotiations
